title: 327 - Choices, costs, and challenges in US healthcare: insurance, drug pricing, & potential reforms
summary: On Peter Attia's podcast, Tenet Healthcare CEO Saum Sutaria, formerly of McKinsey, walks through the structure and financial flows of the US healthcare system. They cover insurance, drug pricing, how the system evolved and possible reforms.
why: HN commenters point to it as a detailed primer on why US healthcare is expensive and where the money goes.

quote.text: The best primer on the choices that make our healthcare expensive, and where the money goes, are in this video
